subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Tue Sep 22 shortlist | CIEN upgrade + 3 more, thin day — 4 candidates
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Shortlist

Tuesday, September 22, 2026 — Kuwait time

4 candidates cleared all gates

Thin day vs. the usual 5-10 — 15 raw names investigated, 11 cut. Best setup: CIEN (see below).

Two names (MPC, UNP) that web search reported as breaking out were dropped after IBKR showed the moves had already reversed hard — exactly the stale-narrative trap this scan exists to catch.

Account context

~$535 net liq (last IBKR-verified 2026-08-25) · $330.60 cash available per portfolio.json · 2 positions already open (GOOG, SPXC — SPXC has its own overdue defense-rule exit flagged separately by daily-portfolio-check, not actioned here). At 15% sizing (~$80/position), cash covers roughly 4 new entries — size down if entering more than 2-3 at once to keep 5-7 total concurrent positions in view.

Momentum Shortlist

30 web searches + IBKR topic/price confirmation across small, mid, and large caps. Run stock-analyzer on any name for the full deep dive.
#1 — CIEN Ciena Corp ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5

Communication Services / Optical Networking  ·  LARGE CAP

Signal: Evercore ISI upgraded to Outperform from In-Line and raised its PT to $550 from $375 on Monday (Sep 21) — one of the largest single-day PT hikes in this scan. Stock closed +4.9% Monday and is following through +1.3% live today. — 1 trading day ago

Price: $370.82 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$700M+ (heavy, ~1.9M sh/day)  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — recovered from a Sep 3 low of $317.46 during the broader semiconductor-sentiment selloff while SPY held up better, now leading the bounce

Why it's interesting: Optical networking / data-center interconnect name riding the same AI-infrastructure capex wave as the fiber/hyperscaler trade, but already large and liquid — sidesteps the exit-liquidity problem the smaller AI-adjacent names in this scan carry. The upgrade landed right as the stock was basing after a hard pullback, not after an extended run.

Realistic near-term target: +6-11% over 5-10 trading days — filling back toward the $385-400 zone (the pre-selloff August range), not the $550 street target

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $358-362 — today's +1.3% follow-through on top of Monday's +4.9% already extends the move; chasing here gives a poor risk:reward

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $360.00 · stop-limit trigger $348.50 / limit $347.00 (below the Sep 18 pre-upgrade close $348.80) · TP1 sell limit $385.00 · TP2 $400.00 · size ~0.222 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 2.1:1

Event window: No dated catalyst in the near-term window (next earnings ~Dec) — catalyst already behind it ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified — telecom/networking equipment, no haram exposure

Defense/military check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: Requires fractional shares (0.222) — confirmed working on IBKR per portfolio history

Next step: analyze CIEN
#2 — CRWD CrowdStrike Holdings ⭐⭐⭐ 3/5

Cybersecurity SaaS  ·  LARGE CAP

Signal: Morgan Stanley reiterated Overweight, raised PT to $254 from $238, Monday (Sep 21). Stock is $1.37 (0.5%) under its own 52-week high of $250.32, set Sep 17, after a ~30% run over the past month. — 1 trading day ago (PT raise); has not yet broken to new highs

Price: $248.95 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$2B+ (extremely liquid, ~8M sh/day)  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — sitting at 52-week highs while sector sentiment was choppy mid-September

Why it's interesting: Coiling right under resistance, not extended off a base — a breakout-confirmation setup rather than a chase. The PT raise adds a fresh reason for the name to clear its own high this week.

Realistic near-term target: +4-8% over 5-10 trading days toward $262-270 — typical initial extension for a mega-cap resistance break

Entry read: WAIT FOR BREAKOUT confirmation above $250.35 on volume — do not buy the flat consolidation itself

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY stop-limit trigger $250.50 / limit $251.50 (breakout entry) · protective stop-limit trigger $245.50 / limit $244.50 (~2% below entry) · TP1 sell limit $262.00 · TP2 $270.00 · size ~0.319 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 2.2:1

Event window: Next earnings ~early Dec — behind this trade's window ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified — cybersecurity software, no haram exposure

Defense/military check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: Requires fractional shares (0.319)

Next step: analyze CRWD
#3 — FTK Flotek Industries ⭐⭐⭐ 3/5

Energy — Oilfield Data/Chemistry  ·  SMALL CAP

Signal: Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $360-370M (from $340-350M) on Sep 9. Unlike several other "earnings pop" names cut from this scan, the move never faded — FTK kept grinding to new highs through Sep 18 ($31.58 intraday) and is only ~3% off that peak. — original catalyst 9 trading days ago, but new highs made as recently as 3 trading days ago (still intact)

Price: $30.71 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$15.7M  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — up ~28% over the past month

Why it's interesting: Real continuation, not a one-day pop — the stock has made a higher high in 4 of the last 6 sessions. Small float means moves can be sharp both ways.

Realistic near-term target: +9-17% over 5-10 trading days toward $33.50-36 — approaching the older 13-week high near $39.60 set before an August retracement

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET / acceptable pullback to $29.80-30.00

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $30.75 · stop-limit trigger $29.55 / limit $29.35 (below the Sep 18 low $29.83, the breakout shelf) · TP1 sell limit $33.50 · TP2 $36.00 · size ~2.6 shares ≈ $80 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 2.3:1

Event window: Next earnings ~early Nov — behind this trade's window, catalyst already resolved ✅

Halal: ✅ Verified — oilfield chemistry/data analytics services, no haram exposure

Defense/military check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: ~2.6 fractional shares at $80; commission round-trip (~$2) is ~2.5% of position — target ≥5% to clear it comfortably (this trade's targets do)

Next step: analyze FTK
#4 — KEEL Keel Infrastructure Corp ⭐⭐⭐ 3/5

AI Data Center / Infrastructure  ·  SMALL/MICRO CAP  ·  ⚠️ FLAGGED — read before trading

Signal: Up ~25% over the past week on a Sep 17 contract/megaproject announcement tied to its pivot from bitcoin mining into AI/HPC data-center leasing (Panther Creek, Sharon, Moses Lake campuses). Still printing higher lows every session through Sep 21 — uninterrupted momentum. — 3 trading days ago, still intact

Price: $4.07 (IBKR, prior close)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$100-190M (share-count based; IBKR's $-volume field did not return, estimated from price × share volume)  |  RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming

Why it's flagged, not just interesting: Reporting on the Sep 17 catalyst is inconsistent — some outlets describe it as a commercial AI/hyperscaler lease, at least one describes it as a "government infrastructure contract" and another as a "government rail upgrade contract." The company's stated core business (leasing data-center capacity for AI/HPC) is halal-clean and not defense-related, but this scan could not pin down the counterparty or nature of the specific Sep 17 deal well enough to rule out a government/defense angle. Per the standing rule on defense/government-contract-driven moves, confirm what the contract actually is before entering — if it turns out to be DoD/military-linked, this name is dead regardless of the technical setup.

Realistic near-term target: +8-20% over 3-7 trading days toward $4.50-5.00 — high-volatility microcap, size accordingly

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET only after the contract is confirmed clean — do not chase above $4.25 in the meantime

Order plan (GTC, all legs together — hold until halal/defense confirmed):
BUY limit $4.15 · stop-limit trigger $3.95 / limit $3.88 (below the Sep 21 low $4.02) · TP1 sell limit $4.50 · TP2 $5.00 · size ~19 shares ≈ $79 (~15%) · R:R ≈ 1.75:1

Event window: No confirmed earnings date found (recently public) — unknown, not flagged as a binary risk given the leasing/real-estate-style model

Halal: ⚠️ Unverified — core business clean, but the specific Sep 17 contract's counterparty is unconfirmed

Defense/military check: ⚠️ Unresolved — confirm before entering, no exceptions

Sizing note: ~19 whole shares at $4.15, no fractional needed; heavy debt (>$1.01B) and negative free cash flow (-$95.9M) offset by $715M cash — a speculative turnaround story, not a balance-sheet-quality name

Next step: analyze KEEL (and resolve the contract question first)

🏆 Today's best setup

CIEN — the freshest, cleanest signal in the scan: a major sell-side upgrade with one of the largest single-day price-target hikes seen here ($375→$550), landing right as the stock was basing after a hard September pullback rather than after an extended run. It's large-cap liquid, halal-clean, has no near-term dated event risk, and IBKR live data confirms the move is continuing today rather than fading. Invalidation: a close back below $348.80 (the pre-upgrade Sep 18 level) — that would mean the upgrade thesis failed to hold and the name is back in its prior range.

Cut this run — 11 names investigated and dropped

UNP — search reported a fresh UBS upgrade to Buy, but IBKR shows a steady ~13% monthly decline and a sharp high-volume drop (-4.2%) on the most recent session — directly contradicts the search narrative. Textbook stale-narrative trap.
MPC — search said fresh 52-week-high breakout; IBKR shows the stock already rolled over, down ~5.6% from its Sep 18 peak with another red day today. FADED.
VLO — same pattern as MPC: down ~6.7% off its Sep 18 peak, red again today. FADED.
CAL (Caleres) — reported +14% earnings pop (Sep 9) was an intraday spike that faded by the close; stock has since drifted below even that day's closing level. FADED, stale.
IRD (Opus Genetics) — +61.6% biotech trial-data pop already ~25% off its post-pop high. Extended, high-volatility microcap biotech — in the spirit of the binary-catalyst pause, not chasing a faded readout.
ICHR (Ichor Holdings) — a low-tier "Wall Street Zen" algo upgrade Sep 21, but the stock is still ~50% below its 52-week high and a director sold $1M in stock just two days earlier. Weak, contradictory signal.
CCEC — illiquid (IBKR avg 90-day $ volume ~$203K, too thin for a fast exit) and the actual catalyst (Q2 earnings beat) is stale, not from the last 5 trading days.
USAR (USA Rare Earth) — only +0.7% live, still well off both its 13- and 52-week highs despite a "surging" search narrative. Also excluded on defense-adjacency risk: rare-earth/critical-minerals names are closely tied to defense-supply-chain policy.
EMAT (Evolution Metals) — hard excluded. Coverage of its rally explicitly headlines a "Defense Tailwind" — rare-earth magnets tied to military applications is exactly the defense-contract-driven catalyst this scan excludes, regardless of the (real) Russell 2000/3000 index-inclusion angle.
GSIT (GSI Technology) — the "AI data center momentum" rally being recirculated is actually from May 2026, five months stale. It also carries a U.S. Army SBIR contract in its news mix — defense-contract entanglement even setting the staleness aside.
GLW (Corning) — the Verizon fiber supply deal is from Sep 8, outside the 5-trading-day freshness window, and IBKR's 52-week-high figure for this name looked internally inconsistent — low confidence in the data, cut rather than pass through a possible bad number.

Cap mix: 2 large (CIEN, CRWD), 2 small/micro (FTK, KEEL) — balanced per the no-single-cap-bucket rule. Large-cap energy (MPC, VLO) and large-cap rail (UNP) were all investigated for the mandatory large-cap lane but cut on faded/contradicted signals, not skipped.

Research output, not financial advice. The stock-finder shortlist alone is not enough to enter a trade — it's a first filter; run stock-analyzer before sizing a position. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance on the specific catalyst before entering, especially KEEL. Generated Tue Sep 22 2026, Kuwait time, via live WebSearch + IBKR confirmation.
